payload.text: hv, 2026-10-03: devbin keeps no list of who uses it, in its runtime or its tests (a gate works by shape, and review holds names); the licence is Geodica Ltd's, one text at LICENSE and lib/LICENSE.md held byte-identical by test; every open item is an issue, built by cc, reviewed by vc and landed into one bundled release that hv cuts; intent/docs/devbin-users.md is hv's convenience: ignore it.
